name: Wildlife Explorer
description: Explore animal habitats and discover incredible creatures!

reward.name: Jaguar
reward.fact: Jaguars have the strongest bite of any big cat and love swimming in rivers.

reward.name: Dolphin
reward.fact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open and half their brain awake to watch for danger.

reward.name: Lion
reward.fact: A lion's roar can be heard from five miles away across the savannah.

reward.name: Polar Bear
reward.fact: Polar bears have black skin under their white fur to help absorb heat from the sun.

reward.name: Poison Dart Frog
reward.fact: Poison dart frogs get their toxins from the insects they eat in the rainforest.

reward.name: Fennec Fox
reward.fact: Fennec foxes have huge ears that help them hear prey underground and keep cool in the desert heat.

reward.name: Snow Leopard
reward.fact: Snow leopards can leap up to 15 metres in a single bound across mountain gaps.

reward.name: Cheetah
reward.fact: Cheetahs are the fastest land animals and can run at 70 miles per hour.
